en.title: NDIS Funding Cuts Spark Fight as Accessible Playground and Train Launch
en.summary: Dane Waites’ NDIS funding was slashed after a historical abuse payout, prompting him and his mother to challenge the decision. Meanwhile, Chicago opened its first universally accessible playground on Midway Plaisance, offering inclusive play for children of all abilities. In Finland, the new FLIRT train debuted with full low-floor design, ensuring wheelchair access and flexible spaces for bikes and work.

highlights.title: Dane’s payout for historical sexual abuse meant the NDIS slashed his funding. He and his mum are fighting back
Chicago opens first universally accessible playground on Midway Plaisance
New FLIRT Train in Finland Features Full Low-Floor Accessibility

zh-TW.title: NDIS 資金削減引發爭議 芝加哥無障礙遊樂場及芬蘭低地板列車啟用
zh-TW.summary: 丹恩·懷特斯因歷史性性虐待賠償導致NDIS削減其資金，他與母親正在反擊。芝加哥於 Midway Plaisance 開設首個全民可及遊樂場，提供適合各能力兒童的共融遊戲設施。芬蘭新FLIRT列車採全低地板設計，方便輪椅使用並提供彈性單車與工作空間。
